name: Endeavour (STS-67)
about: Endeavour (STS-67) (1995-007A), a crewed vehicle (OV-105), launched 1995 Mar  2. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1995 Mar  9), held fixed
GCAT names the site (EAFB RW22); its coordinates are written from memory
